changedVerses.standard: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
changedVerses.custom: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with demons.

changedVerses.standard: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.
changedVerses.custom: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of demons: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of demons.

changedVerses.standard: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.custom: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not love, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

changedVerses.standard: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
changedVerses.custom: And now abideth faith, hope, love, these three; but the greatest of these is love.

changedVerses.standard: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
changedVerses.custom: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not love, I am nothing.

changedVerses.standard: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
changedVerses.custom: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not love, it profiteth me nothing.

changedVerses.standard: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
changedVerses.custom: Love suffereth long, and is kind; love envieth not; love vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

changedVerses.standard: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
changedVerses.custom: Love never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

changedVerses.standard: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
changedVerses.custom: Follow after love, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.

changedVerses.standard: Let all your things be done with charity.
changedVerses.custom: Let all your things be done with love.

changedVerses.standard: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
changedVerses.custom: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Spirit teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

changedVerses.standard: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
changedVerses.custom: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?

changedVerses.standard: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
changedVerses.custom: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but love edifieth.

changedVerses.standard: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
changedVerses.custom: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit: and these three are one.

changedVerses.standard: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
changedVerses.custom: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conduct;

changedVerses.custom: Having your conduct honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

changedVerses.custom: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conduct in Christ.

changedVerses.standard: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
changedVerses.custom: While they behold your chaste conduct coupled with fear.

changedVerses.standard: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

changedVerses.custom: And above all things have fervent love among yourselves: for love shall cover the multitude of sins.

changedVerses.custom: Greet ye one another with a kiss of love. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

changedVerses.custom: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and love and holiness with sobriety.

changedVerses.custom: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Spirit: as your fathers did, so do ye.

changedVerses.standard: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
changedVerses.custom: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

changedVerses.standard: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
changedVerses.custom: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit:

changedVerses.standard: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
changedVerses.custom: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Spirit was given, he offered them money,

changedVerses.standard: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
changedVerses.custom: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, were multiplied.

changedVerses.standard: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?
changedVerses.custom: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?

changedVerses.standard: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
changedVerses.custom: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor precede us.

changedVerses.standard: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
changedVerses.custom: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.

changedVerses.standard: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
changedVerses.custom: And above all these things put on love, which is the bond of perfectness.

changedVerses.standard: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer thee in this matter.
changedVerses.custom: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not anxious to answer thee in this matter.

changedVerses.standard: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
changedVerses.custom: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy grain, and thy wine, and thine oil.

changedVerses.standard: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:
changedVerses.custom: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy grain, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

changedVerses.standard: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.
changedVerses.custom: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.

changedVerses.standard: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.
changedVerses.custom: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy grain, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.

changedVerses.standard: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:
changedVerses.custom: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy grain and thy wine:

changedVerses.standard: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.
changedVerses.custom: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the grain.

changedVerses.standard: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
changedVerses.custom: The firstfruit also of thy grain, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.

changedVerses.standard: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour's standing corn.
changedVerses.custom: When thou comest into the standing grain of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour's standing grain.

changedVerses.standard: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
changedVerses.custom: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the grain.

changedVerses.standard: And the LORD hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;
changedVerses.custom: And the LORD hath avouched thee this day to be his special people, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;

changedVerses.standard: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
changedVerses.custom: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either grain, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.

changedVerses.standard: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
changedVerses.custom: They sacrificed unto demons, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

changedVerses.standard: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
changedVerses.custom: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of grain and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

changedVerses.standard: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
changedVerses.custom: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy grain, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

changedVerses.standard: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
changedVerses.custom: Having predestinated us unto the sonship of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

changedVerses.standard: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
changedVerses.custom: Among whom also we all had our conduct in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

changedVerses.standard: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
changedVerses.custom: That ye put off concerning the former conduct the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

changedVerses.standard: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
changedVerses.custom: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

changedVerses.standard: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
changedVerses.custom: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the grain, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.

changedVerses.standard: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
changedVerses.custom: For ye have heard of my conduct in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

changedVerses.standard: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
changedVerses.custom: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the sonship of sons.

changedVerses.standard: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
changedVerses.custom: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience and mercy, kindness, goodness and generosity, faith,

changedVerses.standard: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
changedVerses.custom: Meekness and humility, self-control: against such there is no law.

changedVerses.standard: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
changedVerses.custom: And the earth became without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

changedVerses.standard: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
changedVerses.custom: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up his spirit and died; and was gathered unto his people.

changedVerses.standard: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
changedVerses.custom: Then Abraham gave up his spirit, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

changedVerses.standard: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
changedVerses.custom: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and wine:

changedVerses.standard: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
changedVerses.custom: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with grain and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

changedVerses.standard: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
changedVerses.custom: And Isaac gave up his spirit, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

changedVerses.standard: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
changedVerses.custom: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

changedVerses.standard: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
changedVerses.custom: And Joseph gathered grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

changedVerses.standard: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
changedVerses.custom: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of grain came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

changedVerses.standard: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
changedVerses.custom: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy grain; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

changedVerses.standard: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
changedVerses.custom: Now when Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

changedVerses.standard: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
changedVerses.custom: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry grain for the famine of your houses:

changedVerses.standard: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
changedVerses.custom: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

changedVerses.standard: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
changedVerses.custom: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with grain, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

changedVerses.standard: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
changedVerses.custom: And they laded their asses with the grain, and departed thence.

changedVerses.standard: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
changedVerses.custom: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy grain in Egypt.

changedVerses.standard: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
changedVerses.custom: And the sons of Israel came to buy grain among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

changedVerses.standard: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
changedVerses.custom: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

changedVerses.standard: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
changedVerses.custom: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his grain money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

changedVerses.standard: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
changedVerses.custom: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with grain and bread and meat for his father by the way.

changedVerses.standard: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.
changedVerses.custom: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

changedVerses.standard: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
changedVerses.custom: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up his spirit, and was gathered unto his people.

changedVerses.standard: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.
changedVerses.custom: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the grain, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.

changedVerses.standard: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
changedVerses.custom: Whereof the Holy Spirit also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

changedVerses.standard: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
changedVerses.custom: Let your conduct be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

changedVerses.standard: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
changedVerses.custom: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conduct.

changedVerses.standard: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
changedVerses.custom: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

changedVerses.standard: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
changedVerses.custom: Wherefore (as the Holy Spirit saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

changedVerses.standard: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
changedVerses.custom: For the word of God is living, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

changedVerses.standard: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
changedVerses.custom: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

changedVerses.standard: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
changedVerses.custom: The Holy Spirit this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

changedVerses.standard: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
changedVerses.custom: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the grain; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.

changedVerses.standard: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
changedVerses.custom: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the grain, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

changedVerses.standard: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
changedVerses.custom: And the earth shall hear the grain, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.

changedVerses.standard: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
changedVerses.custom: For she did not know that I gave her grain, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.

changedVerses.standard: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
changedVerses.custom: Therefore will I return, and take away my grain in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.

changedVerses.standard: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
changedVerses.custom: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for grain and wine, and they rebel against me.

changedVerses.standard: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
changedVerses.custom: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his baggage:

changedVerses.standard: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
changedVerses.custom: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the grain, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

changedVerses.standard: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
changedVerses.custom: O my threshing, and the grain of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

changedVerses.standard: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.
changedVerses.custom: Bread grain is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.

changedVerses.standard: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
changedVerses.custom: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

changedVerses.standard: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
changedVerses.custom: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as grain blasted before it be grown up.

changedVerses.standard: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
changedVerses.custom: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy grain to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:

changedVerses.standard: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
changedVerses.custom: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the demons also believe, and tremble.

changedVerses.standard: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
changedVerses.custom: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conduct his works with meekness of wisdom.

changedVerses.standard: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.
changedVerses.custom: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up her spirit; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.

changedVerses.standard: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
changedVerses.custom: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be anxious in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

changedVerses.standard: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
changedVerses.custom: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up my spirit, and no eye had seen me!

changedVerses.standard: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
changedVerses.custom: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the spirit.

changedVerses.standard: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
changedVerses.custom: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up my spirit.

changedVerses.standard: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
changedVerses.custom: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up his spirit, and where is he?

changedVerses.standard: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
changedVerses.custom: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

changedVerses.standard: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
changedVerses.custom: They reap every one his grain in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

changedVerses.standard: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
changedVerses.custom: Canst thou bind the wild ox with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

changedVerses.standard: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
changedVerses.custom: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with grain; they go forth, and return not unto them.

changedVerses.standard: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
changedVerses.custom: Will the wild ox be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?

changedVerses.standard: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
changedVerses.custom: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up my spirit when I came out of the belly?

changedVerses.standard: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
changedVerses.custom: Why did the knees precede me? or why the breasts that I should suck?

changedVerses.standard: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
changedVerses.custom: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of grain cometh in in his season.

changedVerses.standard: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
changedVerses.custom: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the grain is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

changedVerses.standard: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
changedVerses.custom: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the grain is withered.

changedVerses.standard: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
changedVerses.custom: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you grain, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:

changedVerses.standard: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
changedVerses.custom: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a grain of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

changedVerses.standard: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
changedVerses.custom: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

changedVerses.standard: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
changedVerses.custom: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up His Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
changedVerses.custom: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Spirit:

changedVerses.standard: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
changedVerses.custom: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Spirit was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

changedVerses.standard: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
changedVerses.custom: And they did eat of the old grain of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched grain in the selfsame day.

changedVerses.standard: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
changedVerses.custom: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old grain of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

changedVerses.standard: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
changedVerses.custom: These are spots in your feasts of love, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

changedVerses.standard: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
changedVerses.custom: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,

changedVerses.standard: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.
changedVerses.custom: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing grain, with the vineyards and olives.

changedVerses.standard: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
changedVerses.custom: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up their spirit in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.

changedVerses.standard: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
changedVerses.custom: They say to their mothers, Where is grain and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.

changedVerses.standard: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
changedVerses.custom: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the Azazel, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for an Azazel into the wilderness.

changedVerses.standard: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
changedVerses.custom: And he that let go the goat for the Azazel shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

changedVerses.standard: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
changedVerses.custom: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the Azazel.

changedVerses.standard: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
changedVerses.custom: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto demons, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

changedVerses.standard: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
changedVerses.custom: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

changedVerses.standard: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
changedVerses.custom: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of grain dried by the fire, even grain beaten out of full ears.

changedVerses.standard: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
changedVerses.custom: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten grain thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

changedVerses.standard: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
changedVerses.custom: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject unto us through thy name.

changedVerses.standard: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
changedVerses.custom: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art anxious and troubled about many things:

changedVerses.standard: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
changedVerses.custom: But some of them said, He casteth out demons through Beelzebub the chief of the demons.

changedVerses.standard: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
changedVerses.custom: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out demons through Beelzebub.

changedVerses.standard: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
changedVerses.custom: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

changedVerses.standard: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
changedVerses.custom: But if I with the finger of God cast out demons, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

changedVerses.standard: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
changedVerses.custom: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Spirit it shall not be forgiven.

changedVerses.standard: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
changedVerses.custom: For the Holy Spirit shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

changedVerses.standard: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
changedVerses.custom: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out demons, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

changedVerses.standard: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
changedVerses.custom: If any man come to me, and love less than his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

changedVerses.standard: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
changedVerses.custom: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.

changedVerses.standard: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
changedVerses.custom: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Spirit shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

changedVerses.standard: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
changedVerses.custom: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit:

changedVerses.standard: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
changedVerses.custom: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

changedVerses.standard: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
changedVerses.custom: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, He gave up His Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
changedVerses.custom: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

changedVerses.standard: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
changedVerses.custom: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Spirit, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

changedVerses.standard: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
changedVerses.custom: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire:

changedVerses.standard: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
changedVerses.custom: And the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

changedVerses.standard: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
changedVerses.custom: And Jesus being full of the Holy Spirit returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

changedVerses.standard: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
changedVerses.custom: And demons also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

changedVerses.standard: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
changedVerses.custom: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the grain fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of grain, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

changedVerses.standard: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
changedVerses.custom: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven demons,

changedVerses.standard: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
changedVerses.custom: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had demons long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

changedVerses.standard: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
changedVerses.custom: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many demons were entered into him.

changedVerses.standard: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
changedVerses.custom: Then went the demons out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

changedVerses.standard: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
changedVerses.custom: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the demons were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

changedVerses.standard: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
changedVerses.custom: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the demons was healed.

changedVerses.standard: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
changedVerses.custom: Now the man out of whom the demons were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

changedVerses.standard: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
changedVerses.custom: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

changedVerses.standard: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
changedVerses.custom: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.

changedVerses.standard: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
changedVerses.custom: For David himself said by the Holy Spirit, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

changedVerses.standard: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
changedVerses.custom: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up His Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
changedVerses.custom: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up His Spirit, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

changedVerses.standard: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
changedVerses.custom: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out demons; they shall speak with new tongues;

changedVerses.standard: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
changedVerses.custom: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven demons.

changedVerses.standard: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
changedVerses.custom: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with demons.

changedVerses.standard: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
changedVerses.custom: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many demons; and suffered not the demons to speak, because they knew him.

changedVerses.standard: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
changedVerses.custom: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out demons.

changedVerses.standard: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
changedVerses.custom: And it came to pass, that he went through the grain fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

changedVerses.standard: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
changedVerses.custom: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out demons:

changedVerses.standard: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
changedVerses.custom: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the demons casteth he out demons.

changedVerses.standard: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
changedVerses.custom: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Spirit hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

changedVerses.standard: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
changedVerses.custom: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full grain in the ear.

changedVerses.standard: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
changedVerses.custom: And all the demons besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

changedVerses.standard: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
changedVerses.custom: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.

changedVerses.standard: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
changedVerses.custom: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

changedVerses.standard: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
changedVerses.custom: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out demons: freely ye have received, freely give.

changedVerses.standard: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
changedVerses.custom: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the grain; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of grain, and to eat.

changedVerses.standard: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
changedVerses.custom: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out demons, but by Beelzebub the prince of the demons.

changedVerses.standard: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
changedVerses.custom: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

changedVerses.standard: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
changedVerses.custom: But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.

changedVerses.standard: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
changedVerses.custom: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Spirit shall not be forgiven unto men.

changedVerses.standard: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
changedVerses.custom: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

changedVerses.standard: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
changedVerses.custom: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up His Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
changedVerses.custom: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit:

changedVerses.standard: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
changedVerses.custom: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit, and with fire:

changedVerses.standard: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
changedVerses.custom: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with demons, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

changedVerses.standard: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
changedVerses.custom: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out demons? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

changedVerses.standard: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
changedVerses.custom: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with demons: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

changedVerses.standard: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
changedVerses.custom: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with demons, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.

changedVerses.custom: So the demons besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

changedVerses.standard: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
changedVerses.custom: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the demons.

changedVerses.standard: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
changedVerses.custom: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out demons through the prince of the demons.

changedVerses.custom: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the grain and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

changedVerses.custom: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.
