changedVerses.custom: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and grain: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.

changedVerses.standard: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.
changedVerses.custom: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.

changedVerses.standard: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them, that we may eat, and live.
changedVerses.custom: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up grain for them, that we may eat, and live.

changedVerses.standard: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
changedVerses.custom: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy grain, because of the dearth.

changedVerses.standard: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
changedVerses.custom: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the grain of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

changedVerses.standard: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
changedVerses.custom: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of a wild ox.

changedVerses.standard: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
changedVerses.custom: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of a wild ox: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.

changedVerses.standard: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
changedVerses.custom: Only let your conduct be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

changedVerses.standard: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
changedVerses.custom: For our conduct is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

changedVerses.standard: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
changedVerses.custom: Be anxious for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

changedVerses.standard: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
changedVerses.custom: He that withholdeth grain, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

changedVerses.standard: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
changedVerses.custom: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

changedVerses.standard: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
changedVerses.custom: Mine eyes precede the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

changedVerses.standard: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
changedVerses.custom: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.

changedVerses.standard: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
changedVerses.custom: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conduct.

changedVerses.standard: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
changedVerses.custom: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their grain and their wine increased.

changedVerses.standard: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
changedVerses.custom: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conduct aright will I shew the salvation of God.

changedVerses.standard: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
changedVerses.custom: The God of my mercy shall precede me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

changedVerses.standard: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
changedVerses.custom: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with grain; they shout for joy, they also sing.

changedVerses.standard: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
changedVerses.custom: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them grain, when thou hast so provided for it.

changedVerses.standard: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
changedVerses.custom: There shall be an handful of grain in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

changedVerses.standard: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
changedVerses.custom: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the grain of heaven.

changedVerses.standard: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
changedVerses.custom: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily precede us: for we are brought very low.

changedVerses.standard: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
changedVerses.custom: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer precede thee.

changedVerses.standard: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
changedVerses.custom: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of a wild ox: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

changedVerses.standard: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
changedVerses.custom: For they are the spirits of demons, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.

changedVerses.standard: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
changedVerses.custom: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of demons, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.

changedVerses.standard: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
changedVerses.custom: I know thy works, and love, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.

changedVerses.standard: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
changedVerses.custom: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:

changedVerses.standard: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
changedVerses.custom: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

changedVerses.standard: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
changedVerses.custom: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit which is given unto us.

changedVerses.standard: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
changedVerses.custom: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of sonship, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

changedVerses.standard: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
changedVerses.custom: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the sonship, to wit, the redemption of our body.

changedVerses.standard: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
changedVerses.custom: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Spirit,

changedVerses.standard: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
changedVerses.custom: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the sonship, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

changedVerses.standard: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.
changedVerses.custom: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched grain, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.

changedVerses.standard: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.
changedVerses.custom: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of grain after him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.

changedVerses.standard: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.
changedVerses.custom: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.

changedVerses.standard: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
changedVerses.custom: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a special people, zealous of good works.

changedVerses.standard: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
changedVerses.custom: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in love, in patience.

changedVerses.standard: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
changedVerses.custom: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Spirit;

changedVerses.standard: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.
changedVerses.custom: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent by his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.

changedVerses.standard: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
changedVerses.custom: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! grain shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
